address: Carretera EX-205, Km. 24, Valverde del Fresno, 10890, Spain
bio: This rural hotel for adults only shares the beauty of the Sierra de Gata with its guests. Taking its name from the black stork, a migratory bird which nests in several locations on an estate with over 220ha of holm oak and olive groves, it also features a gourmet boutique next to the bar’s lounge area, an organic olive oil mill and a hammam. In its asador-style restaurant, featuring a semi open-view kitchen and large windows through which guests can gaze out at its surrounding pastures, choose from a regionally inspired à la carte strong on grilled meats, especially those it rears itself, including goat, Iberian pork and RetWagyu beef (a cross between Retinto and Wagyu)....
